::: {#exm-dtype}

#### Two data types for one image

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
pixel_int = images[0, 3, 4]
pixel_float = pixel_int.float()
print(pixel_int, pixel_int.dtype)
print(pixel_float, pixel_float.dtype)
print(pixel_int == pixel_float)
```

In @sol-mean-pixel, the first image is `torch.int64` as loaded and `torch.float32` after `.float()`.
One of its pixels, printed both ways, shows the difference:
the float prints with a decimal point,
the two compare as equal,
and only the [data type](#def-dtype) that stores the value differs.

:::
